comment: Squad comms portrait family. tools/comms_portraits.py reads this file. Prompts describe original generic subjects only. Character looks and row order come from art/comms/cast.json.

keyframe.style: pixel art, 16-bit video game dialogue portrait, head and shoulders bust, facing the viewer, centered in frame, bold dark outline, limited colour palette, crisp cel shading, flat solid light grey background
keyframe.demon: cartoon gargoyle monster character, playful but menacing, expressive face, bat wings folded behind the shoulders
keyframe.negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, gradient background, scenery, landscape, multiple characters, cropped head, hands, gore, blood, nsfw, caricature

edit.keep: Keep exactly the same character, head position, pose, framing, clothing, colours, pixel art style and flat grey background. Change only the facial expression:

human.blink: eyes fully closed in a relaxed blink, everything else unchanged.
human.shout: mouth wide open shouting an urgent order, eyebrows raised, intense eyes.
human.grunt: urgent alarmed expression, eyes wide open with clear irises, eyebrows raised high, mouth half open calling a warning.
human.happy: warm happy smile showing a little teeth, cheerful eyes.
human.worried: worried concerned frown, eyebrows pulled together and up, mouth tight.

demon.blink: eyes fully closed in a slow blink, glow hidden, everything else unchanged.
demon.shout: mouth open barking an order, fangs showing, brow furrowed.
demon.grunt: jaw opened very wide in a huge roar, all fangs bared, tongue visible, eyes glowing brighter.
demon.happy: smug gloating toothy grin, one eyebrow raised, narrowed eyes.
demon.worried: alarmed angry snarl, eyes wide, teeth clenched, ears pinned back.

skarn.extra: bright coral red skin and red-orange scaly hide, brass goggles
skarn.base_edit: Recolour the creature's skin and hide to bright coral red with darker crimson shading; keep the glowing orange eyes; make the horns ivory.

morth.extra: golden yellow skin, bone white armour plates and horns, gold and ivory colours
morth.base_edit: Recolour the skin to pale gold and bone ivory with warm amber shading, and add a third glowing green eye in the middle of the forehead.

admiral.base_edit: Make her look like a dignified woman in her early sixties: silver-grey hair and a few soft smile lines; keep her skin smooth and evenly lit.

ulgra.extra: close-up bust of head and shoulders only, deep crimson red skin, black horns, gold medals
ulgra.base_edit: Recolour the skin to deep crimson red with dark maroon shading, make the eyes glow white, and give it a wide jaw with visible fangs.

march.base_edit: Make her look like a woman in her fifties: add grey streaks through her dark hair and faint smile lines and crow's feet around the eyes.
